changelog:
UI Design System v1.0.0 introduces a comprehensive visual design framework, merging theme selection and aesthetic variants for UI projects.

- Combines theme-factory v1.0.0 (color themes) and ui-styles v1.0.0 (aesthetic variants) into one system.
- Provides 10 preset color themes plus a guided workflow for generating custom palettes, including contrast and naming standards.
- Defines three in-depth aesthetic variants: Soft, Minimalist, and Brutalist, each with unique rules for typography, color, motion, and components.
- Outlines a step-by-step collaboration process to select and apply themes and aesthetics according to project needs.
- Includes best practices and strict "never do" guidelines to ensure visual coherence and accessibility.
summary: UI 视觉设计系统——配色主题（10预设+自定义生成）+ 美学变体（soft/minimalist/brutalist）+ 协同选择流程
